summary: Build practical skills in hazard assessment, monitoring, and incident response. Explore water safety plan training for utility and WASH teams.
lede: Water safety planning helps water-supply teams identify and control drinking-water risks from source to consumer. Designed for utility managers, water-quality officers, public-health teams and WASH practitioners, this training supports building and maintaining practical risk-based plans. Participants practise mapping supply systems, prioritizing hazards, documenting controls, setting monitoring actions, and organizing incident response and periodic review with paper or spreadsheet records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for water safety planning, drinking-water risk controls, public-health protection, or WASH programme delivery.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with water supply operations, water quality, public health, or WASH work is helpful. No treatment-process engineering background or coding is required. A laptop with spreadsheet software is useful for digital exercises; paper-based work can also be used.
